questions.questionTextHi: गोसेन का प्रथम नियम क्या है?
questions.explanation: The law of diminishing marginal utility is a very important principle of consumption. This principle was first propounded by the french economist gossen. That's why this principle is also called gossen's first law. Later Prof. Marshall supported and developed it further. According to Prof Marshall, "The utility derived from an increase in the stock of a commodity possessed by a person, other things remaining the same. it decreases with each unit of quantity of the commodity." Source– Microeconomics, Prof. S.N. Lal, page-13

questions.explanation: A Market system in which there is only one buyer and one seller is called bilateral monopoly. Under bilateral monopoly, one seller on supplier has a monopoly of his commodity or resource and a single buyer has a monopoly of purchasing that commodity or resource. It means to say that Under bilateral monopoly the monopolist faces a purchasing monopolist.

questions.explanation: The process of shifting the monetary burden of tax from the ultimate taxpayer to the payer is called tax deferral. According to Musgrave, "In traditional usage, tax devolution refers to the process by which a direct monetary burden is passed from the point of taxation to the point of stoppage by adjustment of value". According to Professor Bhargava, "Difference of tax can take place only through the process of exchange, that is, the divergence will happen only when the taxed goods are sold and bought". Tax diversions are generally of three types- 1. Shifting through price 2. Forward and Backward tax shifting 3. Tax Capitalization.

(i) All India handloom board (October 1952) (ii) All India handicraft board (November 1952) (iii) All India Khadi and village industries commission (1956) Thus, handloom is important small scale industry in India.
